form.title: Interrogatories - Actions To Establish, Enforce or Modify Child Support Orders
form.court: Superior Court - Family Support Magistrate Division
form.deadline_text: Answers are due within sixty (60) days of filing.

items.label: a
items.prompt: For your present residence:
items.text: What is the address?

items.label: b
items.prompt: For your present residence:
items.text: What type of property is it (apartment, condominium, single-family home)?

items.label: c
items.prompt: For your present residence:
items.text: Who is the owner of the property?

items.label: d
items.prompt: For your present residence:
items.text: What is your relationship to the owner (landlord, parents, spouse)?

items.label: e
items.prompt: For your present residence:
items.text: When did you start living at this residence?

items.label: a
items.prompt: List the names of all the adults that live with you.
items.text: For each adult you live with, what is your relationship to them (spouse, sibling, roommate, parent, girlfriend or boyfriend)?

items.label: b
items.prompt: List the names of all the adults that live with you.
items.text: For each adult you live with, what is their financial contribution to the household (who pays the rent, who pays the utilities, who buys the groceries)?

items.label: a
items.prompt: Give the name and address of your employer.
items.text: Are you employed full-time or part-time? Are you self-employed? If you are self-employed, do not answer (b) through (h) and go directly to Interrogatory #4.

items.label: b
items.prompt: Give the name and address of your employer.
items.text: Are you paid a salary, on an hourly basis, or do you work on commission or tips?

items.label: c
items.prompt: Give the name and address of your employer.
items.text: What is your income per week?

items.label: d
items.prompt: Give the name and address of your employer.
items.text: How many hours per week do you usually work?

items.label: e
items.prompt: Give the name and address of your employer.
items.text: Is overtime available, and if it is, how many hours per week do you work overtime and what are you paid?

items.label: f
items.prompt: Give the name and address of your employer.
items.text: Do you receive, or have you ever received, bonus income from your employment and what is the basis for the bonus?

items.label: g
items.prompt: Give the name and address of your employer.
items.text: Does your employer deduct federal and state taxes and Medicare from your wages or are you responsible for filing your own deductions? If you file, provide a copy of your most recent tax returns.

items.label: h
items.prompt: Give the name and address of your employer.
items.text: Do you have a second source of employment? If so, please provide the same information as requested in (a) through (g).

items.label: a
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: Are you part of a partnership, corporation or LLC, and if you are, give the name of the business and your role in it?

items.label: b
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: Name the other people involved in your business and their roles.

items.label: c
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: Does the business file taxes (if so, bring copies of the last two tax returns filed to your next court date)?

items.label: d
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: Describe the work you do.

items.label: e
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: How many hours per week do you work, on average?

items.label: f
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: How much do you typically earn per hour?

items.label: g
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: List your business expenses, and what they cost per week.

items.label: h
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: State how you are typically paid (check or cash).

items.label: i
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: Name the five people or companies you did most of your work for in the last year.

items.label: j
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: If you have a business account, what bank is it at (bring copies of the last six months of bank statements to your next court date)?

items.label: k
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: Do you work alone or do you employ anyone and pay them wages? If you employ anyone, please identify them, their relationship to you, if any, and the amount you pay them.

items.label: l
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: How do you keep your payment and expense records? Do you employ an accountant, and if so, please give the name and address of the accountant responsible for your records?

Except for your current job, list all the places you have worked for in the last three years. For each place, list the address, the type of work you did, the dates you worked there and how much you were paid at each job.

items.label: a
items.prompt: If you cannot work because of a disability, what is the nature of your disability?
items.text: What is the date you became disabled?

items.label: b
items.prompt: If you cannot work because of a disability, what is the nature of your disability?
items.text: Is this disability permanent or temporary?

items.label: c
items.prompt: If you cannot work because of a disability, what is the nature of your disability?
items.text: If a doctor has told you that you cannot work, what is the name of the doctor and his or her office (bring a note from this doctor stating that you cannot work to your next court date)?

items.label: d
items.prompt: If you cannot work because of a disability, what is the nature of your disability?
items.text: If a doctor has told you that you cannot work, did he or she say you cannot work full-time or part-time?

items.label: e
items.prompt: If you cannot work because of a disability, what is the nature of your disability?
items.text: If you have a partial or permanent disability, please provide the percentage rating.

items.label: f
items.prompt: If you cannot work because of a disability, what is the nature of your disability?
items.text: Is your disability the result of an automobile accident, an accident at work, an accident at home or otherwise? Please give the date and details of the incident and state whether you have filed a lawsuit or workers’ compensation claim as a result.

items.label: g
items.prompt: If you cannot work because of a disability, what is the nature of your disability?
items.text: Have you had any children since the incident? If so, list their dates of birth.

items.label: a
items.prompt: Have you applied for Social Security Disability (SSD) or Supplemental Security Income (SSI)?
items.text: If you did, when did you apply and where are you in the application process?

items.label: b
items.prompt: Have you applied for Social Security Disability (SSD) or Supplemental Security Income (SSI)?
items.text: Have you been told if or when you will receive benefits? If so, who told you and what is the date they gave you?

items.label: c
items.prompt: Have you applied for Social Security Disability (SSD) or Supplemental Security Income (SSI)?
items.text: If your application for SSD and/or SSI has been denied, did you appeal? If you appealed, what is the status of the appeal and what lawyer, if any, represents you?

items.label: d
items.prompt: Have you applied for Social Security Disability (SSD) or Supplemental Security Income (SSI)?
items.text: Have you applied for or are you receiving state assistance?

items.label: e
items.prompt: Have you applied for Social Security Disability (SSD) or Supplemental Security Income (SSI)?
items.text: Are you a recipient of the state supplement program, medical assistance program, temporary family assistance program or state-administered general assistance program (SAGA medical or cash)? If so, state the source of the benefit, the effective date of the benefit and the date when your eligibility for benefits will be redetermined by the Department of Social Services.

items.label: a
items.prompt: Do you have any lawsuits pending?
items.text: If you do, what type of case is it?

items.label: b
items.prompt: Do you have any lawsuits pending?
items.text: Give the name, address, email address and phone number of the lawyer handling the case for you.

items.label: c
items.prompt: Do you have any lawsuits pending?
items.text: What amount do you expect to recover and when do you expect to receive it?

items.label: d
items.prompt: Do you have any lawsuits pending?
items.text: If you have already settled the case, please provide a copy of the settlement statement.

items.prompt: Do you expect to inherit any money or property in the next six months?
items.text: If you do, who do you expect to inherit from and where do they or where did they live?

items.label: b
items.prompt: Do you expect to inherit any money or property in the next six months?
items.text: What do you expect to inherit, what is its value and when do you expect to inherit it?

items.label: c
items.prompt: Do you expect to inherit any money or property in the next six months?
items.text: What is the name and address of the person or lawyer handling the estate and where is the Probate Court in which the action is filed?
Is anyone holding any money for you? If so, name the person, their relationship to you, their address and the amount of money they are holding.

items.label: a
items.prompt: Do you own any rental properties, by yourself, with someone else or in trust? If the answer is yes:
items.text: Is the property residential or commercial?

items.label: b
items.prompt: Do you own any rental properties, by yourself, with someone else or in trust? If the answer is yes:
items.text: Please identify the location of the property or properties, include the address and identify your ownership interest.

items.label: c
items.prompt: Do you own any rental properties, by yourself, with someone else or in trust? If the answer is yes:
items.text: Do you derive any income from the property? Do you calculate your net income from the property on a weekly, monthly or yearly basis?

items.label: d
items.prompt: Do you own any rental properties, by yourself, with someone else or in trust? If the answer is yes:
items.text: What are your expenses relating to the property or properties? Please state the amount of your mortgage payment, if any, and the amount of your taxes, insurance and utility payments, if any, and your method of payment of these expenses.

items.label: e
items.prompt: Do you own any rental properties, by yourself, with someone else or in trust? If the answer is yes:
items.text: Did you have to apply for a loan to finance any part of the real property or to finance the purchase of any personal property? If so, identify the item, state the amount of the loan and give a copy of the loan application.

items.label: a
items.prompt: Are you the beneficiary or settlor of a trust?
items.text: If so, please identify the trust, the type of trust, the date of the creation of the trust, the name and address of the trustee and how the trust is funded.

items.label: b
items.prompt: Are you the beneficiary or settlor of a trust?
items.text: How often do you receive a distribution from the trust and from whom and in what amounts are the distributions?
